mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies around the Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 85 degrees, though the air quality index is currently at a moderate 55.

The City Clerk is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students to design the official sticker for the November election, with community voting scheduled between July 28 and August 7. Also, residents are reminded to check their mailboxes before the winter season to ensure they meet USPS specifications and avoid damage during plow operations.
We have a busy couple of days ahead with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.
Reflecting on the weekly report, on July 13, officers responded to a situation where a driver was arrested for an O-W-I after getting their vehicle stuck on a large rock.
It is a great day to visit Culver's for the OREO Cookie Overload flavor of the day, and you have plenty of time to get there since they remain open until 10 PM.
